header.name: Program Analysis
header.description: This course covers classic and advanced topics in static and dynamic program analysis, including dataflow analysis, interprocedural analysis, symbolic execution, and runtime monitoring.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Implement a dataflow analysis using Soot static analyzer.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Use a symbolic execution tool to generate test cases.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Implement a simple flow-sensitive inter-procedural analysis.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Develop aspects to analyze a program dynamically.

lecture_topics: Classic problems in static program analysis
monotone data flow framework including lattice concepts
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: A programming assignment to implement basic dataflow analyses using Soot.

lecture_topics: Introduction to advanced topics including interprocedural analysis and symbolic execution
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: A programming assignment involving an implementation of a simple interprocedural dataflow analysis using Soot. Another assignment will involve using a symbolic execution tool to generate test cases.
A programming assignment to implement runtime monitors using aspects.

resources.title: Principles of Program Analysis by Nielson, Nielson and Hankin.
Data Flow Analysis: Theory and Practice by Khedker, Sanyal and Karkare.
Compilers: Principles, Techniques, and Tools by Aho, Lam, Sethi and Ullman.
Research papers as assigned by the instructor
